scope: corpus-level response-audio integrity and collection-confound review before machine acceptance or human criterion analysis

hard_blockers.missing_response_audio: manifest response audio does not exist
hard_blockers.undecodable_response_audio: response audio cannot be opened/decoded by the supported audio stack
hard_blockers.empty_response_audio: decoded response has zero frames or non-positive duration
hard_blockers.development_held_exact_audio_hash_overla: the same response-audio bytes appear in both development and held
hard_blockers.development_held_source_recording_overla: the same source_recording_id appears in both development and held
hard_blockers.speaker_split_leakage: the same learner/native speaker identity appears in development and held
hard_blockers.undeclared_exact_duplicate_response: different sample ids contain byte-identical response audio without declaring the same source_recording_id/channel relationship

review_only_principles.signal_quality: clipping, low level, duration, stereo, sample-rate and subtype findings are review signals; they do not automatically make a learner response invalid
review_only_principles.device_metadata: device imbalance/confounding is reported at speaker level and never used to infer learner ability
review_only_principles.mixed_formats: mixed formats may be acceptable when intentional and must not be silently normalized into a scientific quality label
review_only_principles.same_split_duplicates: exact duplicates inside one split are blocked only when they are presented as independent samples without an explicit shared-source relationship

response_vs_context_boundary.reason: the same prompt/preceding-turn context may legitimately be reused across multiple response samples and splits

decision_semantics.collection_blocked: one or more hard blockers exist; do not freeze machine acceptance or criterion analysis until resolved
decision_semantics.collection_ready_with_review: no hard blocker exists, but review-only findings should be inspected and documented
decision_semantics.collection_ready: no hard blocker and no review-only findings were detected

explicit_non_claims: this audit is not a pronunciation score
this audit is not a recording-quality ability score
this audit does not prove construct validity
this audit does not authorize automatic deletion of difficult or accented learner speech
this audit does not change ProductScore
